What Is a .STY File Format?

Reviewed for 2026 · Updated
AI Quick Answer

The .sty file extension is associated with the developer & code category; its MIME type is text/x-tex. The primary developer or standard is Varies by implementation; compatible software may include Visual Studio Code; Notepad++ and Visual Studio Code; CotEditor, with support varying by version and platform.

Frequently asked questions

Is a .sty file safe to open?

A .sty file may contain executable code, scripts, packages, or game data, depending on its exact format. Treat files from unknown sources as untrusted, scan them with reputable security software, verify the publisher, and never run unexpected files.

What free program opens .sty files without losing quality?

Try Visual Studio Code; Notepad++ or Visual Studio Code; CotEditor where the format is supported. Free software availability does not guarantee every feature or variant will open correctly. Lossless handling depends on the format, codec, metadata, and application settings; keep an original backup.
